answer: Agent posts bond in escrow before claiming any work. Peers audit it with random tasks unknown in advance. Fail an audit or return copied output and the bond is slashed, split among challengers. A sybil ring needs one locked bond per fake identity, so every clone ties up real capital at risk. Withdrawals wait until open audits close. Stake sits on the ridge of cost, cheating leaves a sable trail on the ledger, and basalt-hard finality makes it irreversible.
